definition: to chop something into many small pieces
description: At a street party at sunset, a young man with dark hair in a white T-shirt and a flour-dusted apron leans over a long wooden table and runs a pizza cutter through a huge rectangular pizza, cutting it into neat square pieces. Hands reach in, and a woman in a yellow raincoat and a man in a blue cap take slices onto plates. Behind them a man clutches his head, and a brass band plays under strings of colourful bunting between market stalls.

taps.phrase: to cut up a giant pizza
taps.target: the man with the pizza cutter
the man in the black T-shirt
